rules: Real single images and original labels; average 2x2 pixels to 14x14, no distractors or hidden permutation.
Source classes 0..5; reserved calibration pairs [0,5],[2,3]; target classes 6..9. Dataset was explored previously, this is a new generator evaluation on an established benchmark.
The prior sees source masks only, after fresh-numeric quality audit. No images, pixel coordinates, correlations, functional ablations, or target labels enter prior training.
Each mask selects exactly 64 of 196 inputs; all retained feature-hidden weights are independent. This tests mask transfer, not nonzero weight tying.

MADE and the frequency control share a seed-fixed random position order and the same generic cardinality rule: force zeros when 64 ones have been selected, force ones when all remaining positions are needed. No image geometry enters this rule.
Remove forced positions from the masked autoregressive NLL (zero contribution); choose generator solely by held-lineage source NLL.
Keep best 75 percent per source task/lineage role after 4-start fresh refits; no near-perfect accuracy cutoff.
Tune every target method, numerical settings, and AR/frequency temperatures on reserved source pairs at exact support budgets. Freeze before generating target cases or evaluating official test.
Eight starts per target case, checkpoint/start chosen by query BCE; official test never selects settings.
Long Adam/SGD: four times the updates at support16/class, source-calibrated neighboring rates and constant/cosine schedules.
Forty-eight target draws are six class pairs, not forty-eight independent task families; report each pair and resample pairs before draws.
Same target update/example budgets; source acquisition and pretraining costs, active parameter counts and FLOPs differ. Query labels count as additional labeled data.
Do not retune after target results. Preserve weak outcomes and simple controls; no universal autoregressive superiority claim.
